heard: Uzziah raised up to son called Hananiah He joined the men to build up the wall The gates were set and the bars were placed We worked in the dust as we heard it call Whose eye the goldsmith worked with care A knee of the perfumer stood there They restored the wall to the broad wall's side Next to repair and the people who stayed Sambalat and Tobiah were furious, The Ammonites and Arabs were furious,
